units.Jeremiah 1:1: The word of God that came upon Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests, who lived in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,
units.Jeremiah 1:2: which became God’s word to him in the days of Josiah son of Amos, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
units.Jeremiah 1:3: It also came in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah, king of Judah, until Jerusalem’s captivity in the fifth month.
units.Jeremiah 1:4: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Jeremiah 1:5: Before I formed you in the belly, I know you; before you came out of the womb, I have consecrated you. I have appointed you a prophet to nations.
units.Jeremiah 1:6: I said, O Master Lord! Behold, I do not know how to speak, because I am young.
units.Jeremiah 1:7: The Lord said to me, Do not say, I am young, because you will go to everyone to whom I send you, and you will speak according to everything I command you.
units.Jeremiah 1:8: Do not fear them, because I am with you to rescue you, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 1:9: The Lord stretched out His hand toward me and touched my mouth. The Lord said to me, Behold, I have put My words into your mouth.
units.Jeremiah 1:10: Behold, today I have appointed you over nations and kingdoms, to uproot, demolish, destroy, build and plant.
units.Jeremiah 1:11: The Lord’s word came to me, saying, What do you see, Jeremiah? I said, A nut-wood staff.
units.Jeremiah 1:12: The Lord said to me, You have seen well, because I am watchful over My words to perform them.
units.Jeremiah 1:13: The Lord’s word came to me a second time, saying, What do you see? I said, A cauldron heated from beneath, its face away from the north.
units.Jeremiah 1:14: The Lord said to me, From the north calamities will be kindled upon all who inhabit the land.
units.Jeremiah 1:15: Because behold, I am summoning all the kingdoms from the north of the land, says the Lord. They will come and each set his throne at the forecourts of Jerusalem’s gates, against all her surrounding walls and against all Judah’s cities.
units.Jeremiah 1:16: I will speak to them with judgment concerning all their evil, because they abandoned Me, sacrificed to foreign gods and bowed down to the works of their hands.
units.Jeremiah 1:17: But you, gird your waist, rise and tell them everything I command you. Do not fear them or be terrified before them, because I am with you to rescue you, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 1:18: Behold, on this day I have made you like a fortified city and like a strong bronze wall against all Judah’s kings, its rulers and the people of the land,
units.Jeremiah 1:19: and they will fight you, but they will certainly not prevail against you, because I am with you to rescue you, said the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 2:2: And He said, Thus says the Lord: I remembered the mercy of your youth and the love of your completion, when you followed the Holy One of Israel, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 2:3: Israel is holy. To the Lord he is the first of His produce. All who devour him will offend; calamities will come upon them, declares the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 2:4: Hear the Lord’s word, house of Jacob and every clan of the house of Israel.
units.Jeremiah 2:5: Thus says the Lord: What offense did your fathers find in Me, that they withdrew far from Me, followed futile things and became futile?
units.Jeremiah 2:6: They did not say, Where is the Lord who brought us up from Egypt’s land, who guided us in the wilderness, in a boundless and impassable land, a waterless and fruitless land, a land through which nothing passed and where no human being lived?
units.Jeremiah 2:7: I brought you into Carmel to eat its fruits and good things, but you entered and polluted My land and made My inheritance an abomination.
units.Jeremiah 2:8: The priests did not say, Where is the Lord? Those holding to the law did not know Me; the shepherds acted ungodly toward Me; the prophets prophesied by Baal and followed what is useless.
units.Jeremiah 2:9: Therefore I will still enter judgment with you, says the Lord, and with your children’s children I will enter judgment.
units.Jeremiah 2:10: Cross over to the islands of Kittim and see; send to Kedar and consider carefully. See whether such things have happened.
units.Jeremiah 2:11: Will nations exchange their gods, though these are not gods? But My people exchanged their glory, from which they will not benefit.
units.Jeremiah 2:12: Heaven was astonished at this and shuddered exceedingly, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 2:13: For My people did two evil things: they abandoned Me, a spring of water of life, and dug broken cisterns for themselves that will not be able to hold water.
units.Jeremiah 2:14: Is Israel a slave, or is he house-born? Why has he become spoil?
units.Jeremiah 2:15: Lions roared over him and raised their voice. They made his land a wilderness, and his cities were demolished so that none inhabited them.
units.Jeremiah 2:16: The sons of Memphis and Tahpanhes knew you and mocked you.
units.Jeremiah 2:17: Has abandoning Me not brought these things upon you? says the Lord your God.
units.Jeremiah 2:18: Now what do you have to do with Egypt’s road, to drink Gihon’s water? And what do you have to do with the Assyrians’ road, to drink river waters?
units.Jeremiah 2:19: Your apostasy will discipline you, and your evil will rebuke you. Know and see that abandoning Me is bitter for you, says the Lord your God; and I took no pleasure in you, says the Lord your God.
units.Jeremiah 2:20: For long ago you shattered your yoke and tore apart your bonds, and said, I will not be enslaved, but I will go upon every high hill and beneath every shady tree; there I will abandon myself to my prostitution.
units.Jeremiah 2:21: But I planted you as a fruitful vine, wholly genuine. How have you changed into bitterness, you foreign vine?
units.Jeremiah 2:22: Even if you wash with natron and multiply cleansing herb for yourself, you remain stained in your injustices before Me, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 2:23: How will you say, I was not polluted and did not follow Baal? See your ways in the burial ground and know what you did. Late her voice wailed; her ways
units.Jeremiah 2:24: she broadened upon wilderness waters. In her soul’s desires she was carried by the wind; she was handed over. Who will turn her back? All who seek her will not toil; in her humiliation they will find her.
units.Jeremiah 2:25: Turn your foot from a rough road and your throat from thirst. But she said, I will be strong, because she had loved strangers and went after them.
units.Jeremiah 2:26: As a thief is ashamed when caught, so the sons of Israel will be ashamed: they, their kings, their rulers, their priests and their prophets.
units.Jeremiah 2:27: They said to wood, You are my father, and to stone, You gave birth to me. They turned their backs toward Me, not their faces; and in the time of their calamities they will say, Rise and save us!
units.Jeremiah 2:28: Where are your gods that you made for yourself? Will they rise and save you in the time of your affliction? For your gods were as numerous as your cities, Judah, and according to the number of Jerusalem’s streets they sacrificed to Baal.
units.Jeremiah 2:29: Why do you speak to Me? All of you acted ungodly, and all of you acted lawlessly against Me, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 2:30: In vain I struck your children; you accepted no discipline. A sword devoured your prophets like a destroying lion, and you did not fear.
units.Jeremiah 2:31: Hear the Lord’s word. Thus says the Lord: Have I become a wilderness to Israel, or a land left barren? Why did My people say, We will not be ruled, and we will come to Thee no more?
units.Jeremiah 2:32: Will a bride forget her adornment, or a virgin her breastband? Yet My people forgot Me for days beyond counting.
units.Jeremiah 2:33: What good practice will you still pursue in your ways to seek love? Not so; you too acted wickedly to pollute your ways.
units.Jeremiah 2:34: Even on your hands was found the blood of innocent lives. I did not find them in break-ins, but at every oak.
units.Jeremiah 2:35: And you said, I am innocent; let His fury turn away from me. Behold, I enter judgment with you because you say, I did not sin.
units.Jeremiah 2:36: Why did you show such contempt by repeating your ways? You will also be put to shame by Egypt, as you were put to shame by Assyria.
units.Jeremiah 2:37: For from here too you will go out with your hands on your head, because the Lord rejected your hope, and you will not prosper in it.
units.Jeremiah 3:1: If a man sends his wife away, and she leaves him and becomes another man’s, surely she will not return to him again? Would not that woman be utterly polluted? And you prostituted yourself with many shepherds—and were you returning to Me? says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 3:2: Lift your eyes straight ahead and see: where have you not been defiled? You sat for them on the roads like a solitary crow, and polluted the land with your prostitution and your evils.
units.Jeremiah 3:3: You had many shepherds as a stumbling block for yourself. You had a prostitute’s appearance; you were shameless toward everyone.
units.Jeremiah 3:4: Did you not call Me a household, a father and the leader of your virginity?
units.Jeremiah 3:5: Will He remain for ever, or will it be guarded always? Behold, you spoke and did these evil things and were able.
units.Jeremiah 3:6: The Lord said to me in the days of King Josiah, You saw what the dwelling of Israel did to Me. They went upon every high mountain and beneath every wooded tree and prostituted themselves there.
units.Jeremiah 3:7: After she prostituted herself in all these ways, I said, Return to Me. But she did not return, and faithless Judah saw her faithlessness.
units.Jeremiah 3:8: I saw that, concerning all the things in which the dwelling of Israel was caught committing adultery, I sent her away and gave a certificate of divorce into her hands. Yet faithless Judah did not fear; she too went and prostituted herself.
units.Jeremiah 3:9: Her prostitution came to be regarded as nothing, and she committed adultery with wood and stone.
units.Jeremiah 3:10: In all these things faithless Judah did not return to Me with her whole heart, but in falsehood.
units.Jeremiah 3:11: The Lord said to me, Israel has justified himself in comparison with faithless Judah.
units.Jeremiah 3:12: Go and read these words toward the north: Return to Me, dwelling of Israel, says the Lord. I will not set My face firmly against you, because I am merciful, says the Lord, and I will not be angry with you for ever.
units.Jeremiah 3:13: Only recognize your injustice: you acted ungodly toward the Lord your God and spread your ways to strangers beneath every wooded tree, but you did not obey My voice, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 3:14: Return, children who have withdrawn, says the Lord, because I will rule over you. I will take you, one from a city and two from a clan, and bring you into Zion,
units.Jeremiah 3:15: and I will give you shepherds according to My heart, and they will shepherd you, shepherding with knowledge.
units.Jeremiah 3:16: When you multiply and increase upon the land in those days, says the Lord, they will no longer say, The ark of the covenant of the Holy One of Israel. It will not come to mind, be named or be attended to, and it will not be made again.
units.Jeremiah 3:17: In those days and at that time they will call Jerusalem the Lord’s throne, and all the nations will gather to her. They will no longer follow the thoughts of their evil heart.
units.Jeremiah 3:18: In those days the house of Judah will join the house of Israel, and together they will come from the northern land and from all the regions to the land I gave their fathers as an inheritance.
units.Jeremiah 3:19: And I said, May it be, Lord! For I will place you among children and give you a chosen land, an inheritance of God Almighty of nations. I said, You will call Me Father and will not turn away from Me.
units.Jeremiah 3:20: But as a woman deals faithlessly with the one living with her, so the house of Israel dealt faithlessly with Me, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 3:21: A voice was heard from lips, the weeping and supplication of Israel’s children, because they acted unjustly in their ways and forgot their holy God.
units.Jeremiah 3:22: Return, returning children, and I will heal your fractures. Behold, we will be Thy servants, because Thou art the Lord our God.
units.Jeremiah 3:23: Truly the hills and the power of the mountains were false; but through the Lord our God is Israel’s salvation.
units.Jeremiah 3:24: Shame consumed our fathers’ labors from our youth: their sheep and calves, their sons and daughters.
units.Jeremiah 3:25: We lay down in our shame, and our dishonor covered us, because we sinned before our God, we and our fathers, from our youth until this day, and did not obey the voice of the Lord our God.
units.Jeremiah 4:1: If Israel returns, says the Lord, he will return to Me; if he removes his abominations from his mouth and shows reverence before Me,
units.Jeremiah 4:2: and swears, ‘The Lord lives,’ with truth and in judgment and righteousness, then nations will bless in her, and in Him they will praise God in Jerusalem.
units.Jeremiah 4:3: For thus says the Lord to the men of Judah and those dwelling in Jerusalem: Break up fallow ground for yourselves, and do not sow among thorns.
units.Jeremiah 4:4: Be circumcised to your God, and circumcise your hardness of heart, men of Judah and those dwelling in Jerusalem, lest My fury come out like fire and burn, and there be no one to extinguish it because of the evil of your practices.
units.Jeremiah 4:5: Announce in Judah, and let it be heard in Jerusalem; say: Signal with a trumpet over the land, and cry loudly! Say: Gather, and let us enter the walled cities!
units.Jeremiah 4:6: Take up and flee to Zion; hurry, do not stand still, for I am bringing evils from the north and great crushing.
units.Jeremiah 4:7: A lion has gone up from his enclosure; destroying nations, he has set out and left his place to make the land a desolation, and cities will be demolished so that they are not inhabited.
units.Jeremiah 4:8: For these things, gird yourselves with sackcloth, beat yourselves in mourning and wail, because the Lord’s fury has not turned away from you.
units.Jeremiah 4:9: And it will be on that day, says the Lord: the king’s heart and the rulers’ heart will perish, and the priests will be beside themselves and the prophets astonished.
units.Jeremiah 4:10: And I said: O Master, Lord, surely Thou hast indeed deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You will have peace,’ and behold, the sword has reached to their soul!
units.Jeremiah 4:11: At that time they will say to this people and Jerusalem: A spirit of wandering in the wilderness; the daughter of My people’s way is not toward purity or holiness.
units.Jeremiah 4:12: A spirit of filling will come to Me; but now I speak judgments against them.
units.Jeremiah 4:13: Behold, he will come up like a cloud, and his chariots like a storm; his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us, because we suffer misery!
units.Jeremiah 4:14: Wash your heart clean of evil, Jerusalem, so that you may be saved. How long will the schemes of your troubles exist within you?
units.Jeremiah 4:15: For the voice of one announcing will come from Dan, and trouble will be heard from Mount Ephraim.
units.Jeremiah 4:16: Remind the nations: Behold, they have come! Announce in Jerusalem: Bands come from a distant land and have raised their voice against the cities of Judah.
units.Jeremiah 4:17: Like those guarding a field they came against her all around, because you neglected Me, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 4:18: Your ways and your practices have done these things to you. This is your evil: it is bitter; it has reached to your heart.
units.Jeremiah 4:19: My belly, my belly, I am in pain, and the senses of my heart! My soul rages, my heart is torn; I will not be silent, because my soul heard the sound of a trumpet, a cry of war.
units.Jeremiah 4:20: It calls out misery and crushing, because the whole land has suffered misery; suddenly the tent has suffered misery, and my tent coverings have been torn apart.
units.Jeremiah 4:21: How long will I see people fleeing while hearing the sound of trumpets?
units.Jeremiah 4:22: For the leaders of My people did not know Me; they are foolish sons and not discerning. They are wise at doing evil, but did not learn to do well.
units.Jeremiah 4:23: I looked upon the earth, and behold, nothing; and into heaven, and its lights were not there.
units.Jeremiah 4:24: I saw the mountains, and they were trembling, and all the hills were being shaken.
units.Jeremiah 4:25: I looked, and behold, there was no human, and all the birds of heaven were terrified.
units.Jeremiah 4:26: I saw, and behold, Carmel was a wilderness, and all the cities were burned with fire before the Lord, and they vanished before His furious anger.
units.Jeremiah 4:27: Thus says the Lord: The whole land will be a wilderness, but I will certainly not make a complete end.
units.Jeremiah 4:28: For these things let the earth mourn and let heaven above grow dark, because I have spoken and will not change My mind; I have set Myself in motion and will not turn back from it.
units.Jeremiah 4:29: At the sound of a horseman and a drawn bow the whole countryside withdrew; they entered caves and hid in groves and climbed onto the rocks. Every city was abandoned; no human dwells in them.
units.Jeremiah 4:30: And you, what will you do if you put on scarlet and adorn yourself with golden ornaments, and if you paint your eyes with antimony? Your adornment is in vain; your lovers have rejected you; they seek your soul.
units.Jeremiah 4:31: For I heard a voice like a woman in labor, your groaning like one giving birth for the first time, the voice of the daughter of Zion. She will grow faint and let her hands fall: Woe to me, because my soul fails over those killed!
units.Jeremiah 5:1: Run through Jerusalem’s streets and see and learn, and search her squares: if you find a man, if there is one doing justice and seeking faithfulness, then I will be merciful to them, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 5:2: They say, ‘The Lord lives’; do they not therefore swear on falsehoods?
units.Jeremiah 5:3: Lord, Thine eyes are toward faithfulness. Thou didst scourge them, and they did not suffer; Thou broughtest them to an end, and they would not accept instruction. They hardened their faces beyond rock and would not return.
units.Jeremiah 5:4: And I said: Perhaps they are poor, because they had no ability, because they did not know the Lord’s way and God’s judgment.
units.Jeremiah 5:5: I will go to the prosperous and speak to them, for they recognized the Lord’s way and God’s judgment. And behold, with one accord they broke the yoke and tore the bonds.
units.Jeremiah 5:6: Therefore a lion from the woodland struck them, and a wolf destroyed them as far as the houses, and a leopard kept watch over their cities. All who leave them will be hunted, because they multiplied their impieties and grew strong in their turnings away.
units.Jeremiah 5:7: For which of these things should I be merciful to you? Your sons abandoned Me and swore by those who are not gods. And I fed them fully, and they committed adultery and lodged in prostitutes’ houses.
units.Jeremiah 5:8: They became horses mad for mares; each neighed after his neighbor’s wife.
units.Jeremiah 5:9: Shall I not visit for these things? says the Lord. Or will not My soul take vengeance on such a nation?
units.Jeremiah 5:10: Go up against her battlements and tear them down, but do not make a complete end. Leave her supports, because they belong to the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 5:11: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have utterly rejected Me, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 5:12: They lied to their own Lord and said: These things are not so; evils will not come upon us, and we will not see sword or famine.
units.Jeremiah 5:13: Our prophets became wind, and the Lord’s word was not in them. Thus it will be for them.
units.Jeremiah 5:14: Therefore thus says the Lord Almighty: Because you spoke this utterance, behold, I have made My words fire in your mouth, and this people wood, and it will devour them.
units.Jeremiah 5:15: Behold, I am bringing a nation upon you from far away, house of Israel, says the Lord, a nation whose language’s sound you will not understand.
units.Jeremiah 5:17: and they will devour your harvest and your bread, and devour your sons and daughters, and devour your sheep and calves, and devour your vineyards and fig orchards and olive groves; and with a sword they will thresh your fortified cities, in which you have trusted.
units.Jeremiah 5:18: And it will be in those days, says the Lord your God: I will certainly not bring you to a complete end.
units.Jeremiah 5:19: And when you say, ‘For what reason has the Lord our God done all these things to us?’ you will say to them: Because you served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve foreigners in a land not yours.
units.Jeremiah 5:20: Announce these things to the house of Jacob, and let it be heard in Judah.
units.Jeremiah 5:21: Hear these things now, foolish and senseless people: they have eyes and do not see; they have ears and do not hear.
units.Jeremiah 5:22: Will you not fear Me? says the Lord. Or will you not show reverence before Me, who appointed sand as the sea’s boundary, an eternal command it will not cross? It will be stirred and will not prevail, and its waves will roar, and it will not cross it.
units.Jeremiah 5:23: But this people acquired an unheeding and disobedient heart, and they turned aside and went away.
units.Jeremiah 5:24: And they did not say in their heart: Let us fear the Lord our God, who gives us early and late rain at the time of fulfillment of the harvest’s command, and He kept it for us.
units.Jeremiah 5:25: Your lawless acts turned these things aside, and your sins removed good things from you.
units.Jeremiah 5:26: For impious people were found among My people, and they set traps to destroy men and were catching them.
units.Jeremiah 5:27: Like a set trap full of birds, so their houses are full of deceit; therefore they became great and rich.
units.Jeremiah 5:28: And they transgressed judgment; they did not judge an orphan’s case, and they were not judging a widow’s case.
units.Jeremiah 5:29: Shall I not visit for these things? says the Lord. Or will not My soul take vengeance on such a nation?
units.Jeremiah 5:30: Astonishment and horrifying things happened upon the land:
units.Jeremiah 5:31: The prophets prophesy unjust things, and the priests applauded with their hands, and My people loved it so. And what will you do after these things?
units.Jeremiah 6:1: Take courage, sons of Benjamin, from within Jerusalem, and signal with a trumpet in Tekoa, and raise a sign above Beth-haccherem, because evils have looked out from the north, and great crushing is taking place,
units.Jeremiah 6:2: and your height will be taken away, daughter of Zion.
units.Jeremiah 6:3: Shepherds and their flocks will come to her, and they will pitch tents against her all around, and each will shepherd with his own hand.
units.Jeremiah 6:4: Prepare yourselves for war against her! Rise, and let us go up against her at noon! Woe to us, because the day has declined, because evening’s shadows are failing!
units.Jeremiah 6:5: Rise, and let us go up in the night and destroy her foundations!
units.Jeremiah 6:6: For thus says the Lord: Cut down her trees; pour out a force upon Jerusalem. O false city, all oppression is within her!
units.Jeremiah 6:7: As a cistern cools water, so her evil cools; impiety and misery will be heard in her, continually before her. With pain and scourging
units.Jeremiah 6:8: you will be instructed, Jerusalem, lest My soul depart from you, lest I make you an impassable land that will not be inhabited.
units.Jeremiah 6:9: For thus says the Lord: Glean, glean Israel’s remnants like a vine; turn back like the grape-gatherer to his basket.
units.Jeremiah 6:10: To whom shall I speak and testify, and he will hear? Behold, their ears are uncircumcised, and they cannot hear. Behold, the Lord’s utterance became a reproach to them; they certainly will not wish to hear it.
units.Jeremiah 6:11: And I filled up My fury and held back and did not bring them to an end. I will pour it upon little children outside and upon a gathering of young men together, because man and woman will be seized, the elder with one full of days.
units.Jeremiah 6:12: And their houses will be transferred to others, fields and their wives together, because I will stretch out My hand against those dwelling in this land, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 6:13: For from their small to their great, all have carried out lawless deeds; from priest to false prophet, all have done false things.
units.Jeremiah 6:14: And they treated My people’s fracture with contempt, saying, ‘Peace, peace’; and where is peace?
units.Jeremiah 6:15: They were put to shame because they failed, and even so they were not at all ashamed and did not recognize their dishonor. Therefore they will fall in their fall, and at the time of their visitation they will perish, said the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 6:16: Thus says the Lord: Stand upon the roads and see, and ask for the Lord’s eternal paths and see which is the good way, and walk in it, and you will find purification for your souls. And they said, ‘We will not go.’
units.Jeremiah 6:17: I have appointed watchers over you: Hear the trumpet’s sound! And they said, ‘We will not hear.’
units.Jeremiah 6:18: Therefore the nations heard, and those shepherding their flocks.
units.Jeremiah 6:19: Hear, earth! Behold, I am bringing evils upon this people, the fruit of their turning away, because they did not attend to My words and rejected My law.
units.Jeremiah 6:20: Why do you bring Me frankincense from Sheba and cinnamon from a distant land? Your whole burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices did not please Me.
units.Jeremiah 6:21: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am placing weakness upon this people, and fathers and sons together will become weak in it; neighbor and his neighbor will perish.
units.Jeremiah 6:22: Thus says the Lord: Behold, a people comes from the north, and nations will be roused from the earth’s extremity.
units.Jeremiah 6:23: They will grasp bow and spear; it is ruthless and will show no mercy. Its voice is like a surging sea; on horses and chariots it will draw up like fire for war against you, daughter of Zion.
units.Jeremiah 6:24: We heard the report of them; our hands were paralyzed. Affliction seized us, labor pains like a woman giving birth.
units.Jeremiah 6:25: Do not go out into a field or walk on the roads, because the enemies’ sword dwells all around.
units.Jeremiah 6:26: Daughter of My people, gird yourself with sackcloth; sprinkle yourself with ashes. Make mourning for yourself for a beloved one, a pitiful lament, because misery will suddenly come upon you.
units.Jeremiah 6:27: I have made you a tester among tested peoples, and you will know Me when I test their way.
units.Jeremiah 6:28: All are unheeding, walking crookedly, bronze and iron; all are corrupted.
units.Jeremiah 6:29: The bellows failed from the fire; the lead failed. In vain the silversmith works silver; their wickedness was not melted away.
units.Jeremiah 6:30: Call them rejected silver, because the Lord rejected them.
units.Jeremiah 7:2: Hear the Lord’s word, all Judea!
units.Jeremiah 7:3: Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Correct your ways and your practices, and I will settle you in this place.
units.Jeremiah 7:4: Do not put your confidence in yourselves on false words, because they will not benefit you at all when they say, ‘The Lord’s temple, the Lord’s temple it is.’
units.Jeremiah 7:5: For if you truly correct your ways and practices and truly execute judgment between a man and his neighbor,
units.Jeremiah 7:6: and do not oppress a newcomer, orphan, or widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and do not follow foreign gods to your own harm,
units.Jeremiah 7:7: then I will settle you in this place, in the land I gave your fathers, from age to age.
units.Jeremiah 7:8: But if you have trusted false words from which you will receive no benefit,
units.Jeremiah 7:9: and murder and commit adultery and steal and swear unjustly, and you burned incense to Baal and followed foreign gods whom you do not know, to your own harm,
units.Jeremiah 7:10: and you came and stood before Me in the house over which My name has been called and said, ‘We have kept away, so as not to do all these abominations,’
units.Jeremiah 7:11: is My house, over which My name has been called there, a robbers’ cave before you? And behold, I have seen, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 7:12: For go to My place in Shiloh, where I formerly made My name dwell, and see what I did to it because of the evil of My people Israel.
units.Jeremiah 7:13: And now, because you did all these works, and I spoke to you and you did not hear Me, and I called you and you did not answer,
units.Jeremiah 7:14: I will also do to this house over which My name has been called, in which you have trusted, and to the place I gave you and your fathers, as I did to Shiloh.
units.Jeremiah 7:15: And I will throw you away from My presence, as I threw away your brothers, all Ephraim’s offspring.
units.Jeremiah 7:16: And you, do not pray for this people, and do not ask that they receive mercy, and do not pray or approach Me on their behalf, because I will not listen.
units.Jeremiah 7:17: Do you not see what they are doing in Judah’s cities and Jerusalem’s streets?
units.Jeremiah 7:18: Their sons gather wood, and their fathers burn a fire, and their women work dough to make cakes for heaven’s host; and they poured drink offerings to foreign gods to provoke Me to anger.
units.Jeremiah 7:19: Is it Me they provoke to anger? says the Lord. Is it not themselves, so that their faces are put to shame?
units.Jeremiah 7:20: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, My wrath and fury are poured upon this place, upon the people and the livestock, upon every tree of their field and all the earth’s produce; and it will burn and not be extinguished.
units.Jeremiah 7:21: Thus says the Lord: Gather your whole burnt offerings with your sacrifices, and eat meat!
units.Jeremiah 7:22: For I did not speak to your fathers or command them on the day I brought them up from Egypt’s land concerning whole burnt offerings and sacrifice.
units.Jeremiah 7:23: But this utterance I commanded them, saying: Hear My voice, and I will be your God and you will be My people; and walk in all My ways that I command you, so that it may be well with you.
units.Jeremiah 7:24: And they did not hear Me, and their ear did not attend, but they walked in the thoughts of their evil heart and went backward rather than forward.
units.Jeremiah 7:25: From the day their fathers left Egypt’s land until this day, I sent out to you all My servants the prophets by day and at dawn, and I sent them.
units.Jeremiah 7:26: And they did not hear Me, and their ear did not attend, and they hardened their neck beyond their fathers.
units.Jeremiah 7:27–28: And you will say this word to them: This is the nation that did not hear the Lord’s voice or accept instruction; faithfulness failed from their mouth.
units.Jeremiah 7:29: Shear your head and cast it away, and take up a lament on your lips, because the Lord rejected and thrust away the generation doing these things.
units.Jeremiah 7:30: For Judah’s sons did evil before Me, says the Lord; they set their abominations in the house over which My name has been called, to defile it.
units.Jeremiah 7:31: And they built Topheth’s altar, which is in the ravine of the son of Hinnom, to burn up their sons and daughters in fire, which I did not command them and did not conceive in My heart.
units.Jeremiah 7:32: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and they will no longer say Topheth’s Altar or Ravine of the Son of Hinnom, but Ravine of the Slain; and they will bury in Topheth because there is no space.
units.Jeremiah 7:33: And this people’s dead will be food for heaven’s birds and the earth’s wild beasts, and there will be no one to drive them off.
units.Jeremiah 7:34: And I will stop the sound of those rejoicing and the sound of those glad, the voice of bridegroom and the voice of bride, from Judah’s cities and Jerusalem’s thoroughfares, because the whole land will become a desolation.
units.Jeremiah 8:1: At that time, says the Lord, they will bring the bones of Judah’s kings and the bones of its rulers and the bones of the priests and the bones of the prophets and the bones of those dwelling in Jerusalem out of their tombs,
units.Jeremiah 8:2: and expose them to cool before the sun and moon and all the stars and all heaven’s host, which they loved and served and followed and clung to and bowed down to. They will not be mourned or buried, and they will be an example upon the earth’s surface,
units.Jeremiah 8:3: because they chose death rather than life, and for all the remnants left from that generation in every place where I drive them away.
units.Jeremiah 8:4: For thus says the Lord: Does one who falls not rise? Or does one who turns away not return?
units.Jeremiah 8:5: Why has this people of Mine turned away with a shameless turning away, and been held fast in their own choice, and been unwilling to return?
units.Jeremiah 8:6: Give ear now and hear: they will not speak thus; there is no person repenting of his evil, saying, ‘What have I done?’ The runner ceased from his course like a sweating horse in its neighing.
units.Jeremiah 8:7: Even the stork in heaven knew her time; turtledove and swallow, field sparrows, kept the times of their coming, but My people did not know the Lord’s judgments.
units.Jeremiah 8:8: How will you say, ‘We are wise, and the Lord’s law is with us’? A false reed-pen came to be in vain for scribes.
units.Jeremiah 8:9: The wise were ashamed and terrified and captured, because they rejected the Lord’s word. What wisdom is in them?
units.Jeremiah 8:10: Therefore I will give their wives to others and their fields to inheritors,
units.Jeremiah 8:13: and they will gather their produce, says the Lord. There is no grape on the vines and no figs on the fig trees, and the leaves have fallen.
units.Jeremiah 8:14: Why are we sitting? Gather, and let us enter the fortified cities and be cast away, because God cast us away and made us drink gall-water, because we sinned before Him.
units.Jeremiah 8:15: We gathered for peace, and there were no good things; for a time of healing, and behold, haste!
units.Jeremiah 8:16: From Dan we will hear the shrill sound of his horses; at the sound of the neighing of his riding horses the whole earth shook. And he will come and devour the earth and its fullness, a city and those dwelling in it.
units.Jeremiah 8:17: Because behold, I am sending out among you deadly snakes that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you.
units.Jeremiah 8:18: Incurable things, with pain, while your heart is bewildered.
units.Jeremiah 8:19: Behold, the crying voice of the daughter of My people from a distant land: ‘Is the Lord not in Zion? Is a King not there?’ Why did they provoke Me with their carved things and foreign futile things?
units.Jeremiah 8:20: Summer passed, harvest went by, and we were not delivered.
units.Jeremiah 8:21: At the crushing of the daughter of My people I was darkened; in bewilderment, pains like a woman giving birth overpowered me.
units.Jeremiah 8:22: Is there no resin in Gilead, or is there no physician there? Why did healing not rise for the daughter of My people?
units.Jeremiah 8:23: Who will give my head water and my eyes a fountain of tears, and I will weep day and night for this people of Mine, for the wounded of the daughter of My people?
units.Jeremiah 11:18: Lord, make it known to me, and I will know; then I saw their practices.
units.Jeremiah 11:19: But I, like a guileless lamb led to be slaughtered, did not know. Against me they devised an evil design, saying: Come, let us put wood into his bread and wipe him out from the land of the living, and his name will certainly be remembered no more.
units.Jeremiah 11:20: Lord, who judges justly, who tests kidneys and hearts, may I see the vengeance from Thee upon them, because to Thee I revealed my claim of right.
units.Jeremiah 11:21: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the men of Anathoth who seek my soul, who say: You must certainly not prophesy in the Lord’s name; otherwise you will die by our hands.
units.Jeremiah 11:22: Behold, I will visit them; their young men will die by the sword, and their sons and daughters will end their lives in famine,
units.Jeremiah 11:23: and no remnant of them will remain, because I will bring evils upon those dwelling in Anathoth in the year of their visitation.
units.2 Chronicles 34:1: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.
units.2 Chronicles 34:2: He did what was upright before the Lord and walked in the ways of his father David, turning aside neither to the right nor to the left.
units.2 Chronicles 34:3: In the eighth year of his reign, while still a boy, he began to seek the Lord, the God of his father David. In the twelfth year of his reign he began to cleanse Judah and Jerusalem of the high places, sacred groves, and cast objects.
units.2 Chronicles 34:4: He pulled down before him the altars of the Baals and the high places upon them. He cut down the sacred groves, shattered and pulverized the carved and cast objects, and scattered them over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.
units.2 Chronicles 34:5: He burned priests’ bones upon the altars and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.
units.2 Chronicles 34:6: And in the cities of Ephraim, Manasseh, Simeon, and Naphtali, and in their surrounding places,
units.2 Chronicles 34:7: he pulled down the sacred groves and altars, cut the idols into fine pieces, and cut down all the high places throughout the land of Israel. Then he returned to Jerusalem.
units.2 Kings 25:1: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, Nabouchodonosor king of Babylon came with all his force against Jerusalem. He camped against it and built an enclosing wall against it all around.
units.2 Kings 25:2: The city remained under siege until King Sedekias’s eleventh year.
units.2 Kings 25:3: On the ninth of the month the famine grew severe in the city, and there were no loaves for the people of the land.
units.2 Kings 25:4: The city was breached, and all the men of war went out by night by way of the gate between the walls, the one belonging to the king’s garden, with the Chaldeans surrounding the city. He went by the way of the Araba.
units.2 Kings 25:5: The Chaldean force pursued the king and overtook him in Araboth Jericho, and all his force scattered away from him.
units.2 Kings 25:6: They seized the king and brought him to the king of Babylon at Deblatha, and he pronounced judgment upon him.
units.2 Kings 25:7: He slaughtered Sedekias’s sons before his eyes. He blinded Sedekias’s eyes, bound him with fetters, and brought him to Babylon.
units.2 Kings 25:8: In the fifth month, on the seventh of the month, in the nineteenth year of Nabouchodonosor king of Babylon, Nabouzardan, the chief cook who stood before the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
units.2 Kings 25:9: He set fire to the Lord’s house, the king’s house, and all Jerusalem’s houses; every house was set ablaze by
units.2 Kings 25:11: Nabouzardan, the chief cook, removed the rest of the people left in the city, those who had gone over to the king of Babylon, and the remaining support.
units.2 Kings 25:12: The chief cook left some of the land’s poor as vinedressers and as gabin.
units.Isaiah 49:1: Listen to me, islands, and attend, nations. “After a long time it will stand,” says the Lord. From my mother’s belly He called my name,
units.Isaiah 49:2: and made my mouth like a sharp sword. In the shelter of His hand He hid me; He made me a chosen arrow and sheltered me in His quiver.
units.Isaiah 49:3: He said to me, “You are My slave, Israel, and in you I will be glorified.”
units.Isaiah 49:4: I said, “I toiled in vain and gave my strength to futility and nothing. Therefore my judgment is with the Lord, and my toil before my God.”
units.Isaiah 49:5: And now thus says the Lord, who formed me from the belly as His slave to gather Jacob and Israel to Him—I will be gathered and glorified before the Lord, and my God will be my strength—
units.Isaiah 49:6: and He said to me, “It is a great thing for you to be called My servant, to establish Jacob’s tribes and bring back Israel’s dispersion. Behold, I have appointed you as a covenant for a race, a light for nations, so that you may bring salvation to the earth’s extremity.”
units.Exodus 4:10: And Moses said to the Lord, “I beseech Thee, Lord, I have not been capable—not yesterday, nor the day before, nor since Thou didst begin to speak to Thy servant; for I am weak of voice and slow of tongue.”
units.Exodus 4:11: The Lord said to Moses, “Who gave a human being a mouth? Who made one hard of hearing or deaf, seeing or blind? Is it not I, God?
units.Exodus 4:12: Now therefore go, and I will open your mouth, and teach you what you are to speak.”
units.Exodus 4:13: And Moses said, “I beseech Thee, Lord, appoint another who is able, whom Thou wilt send.”
units.Exodus 4:14: And the Lord was kindled with anger against Moses, and said, “Behold, is Aaron the Levite not your brother? I know that he will surely speak to you; and behold, he shall come forth to meet you, and when he sees you, he shall rejoice within himself.
units.Exodus 4:15: And you shall speak to him, and put My words in his mouth; and I will open your mouth and his mouth, and teach you what you shall do.
units.Exodus 4:16: And he shall speak for you to the people, and he shall be your mouth; but you shall be for him in matters pertaining to God.
units.Exodus 4:17: And you shall take in your hand this staff which was turned into a serpent, with which you shall perform the signs.”
units.Deuteronomy 18:15: The Lord your God shall raise up unto you a prophet from among your brethren, like unto me; you shall hearken unto him,
units.Deuteronomy 18:16: according to all that you asked of the Lord your God in Horeb, in the day of the assembly, saying: We will no more hear the voice of the Lord our God, neither will we see this great fire any more, lest we die.
units.Deuteronomy 18:17: And the Lord said unto me: All that they have spoken is right.
units.Deuteronomy 18:18: I will raise up for them a prophet from among their brethren, like unto you, and will put My word in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I command him.
units.Deuteronomy 18:19: And the man who will not hearken unto whatsoever the prophet shall speak in My name, I will exact retribution from him.
units.Deuteronomy 18:20: But the prophet who shall act ungodly, speaking in My name a word which I commanded him not to speak, or who shall speak in the name of other gods, that prophet shall die.
units.Deuteronomy 18:21: And if you say in your heart: How shall we know the word which the Lord has not spoken?
units.Deuteronomy 18:22: Whatsoever the prophet speaks in the name of the Lord, if the word does not come to pass, nor is fulfilled, that is the word which the Lord has not spoken. That prophet has spoken in ungodliness; you shall not spare him.
units.Acts 18:5: When Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul devoted himself to the word, bearing solemn witness to the Jews that Jesus is the Christ.
units.Acts 18:6: When they opposed him and spoke abusively, he shook out his garments and said to them, “Your blood be upon your own heads. I am clean. From now on I will go to the Gentiles.”
units.Acts 18:7: He left there and entered the house of a man named Titius Justus, a worshiper of God, whose house was next to the synagogue.
units.Acts 18:8: Crispus, the synagogue ruler, believed in the Lord with his whole household. Many of the Corinthians who heard believed and were baptized.
units.Acts 18:9: The Lord said to Paul by a vision in the night, “Do not fear, but speak and do not be silent,
units.Acts 18:10: because I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”
units.Acts 18:11: He stayed a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
units.Isaiah 51:12: “I am, I am the One comforting you. Recognize whom you dreaded and feared: a mortal person, a human being who withered like grass.
units.Isaiah 51:13: You forgot God who made you, who made heaven and founded earth, and feared continually, every day, the face of your oppressor’s anger. For as he planned to remove you—where now is your oppressor’s anger?
units.Isaiah 51:14: For as you are saved, it will not stand or linger.
units.Isaiah 51:15: For I am your God, who stirs the sea and makes its waves resound; the Lord Sabaoth is My name.
units.Isaiah 51:16: I will put My words in your mouth and shelter you under My hand’s shadow, by which I established heaven and founded earth; and He will say to Zion, ‘You are My people.’
units.Jeremiah 18:1: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah, saying:
units.Jeremiah 18:2: Rise and go down to the potter’s house, and there you will hear My words.
units.Jeremiah 18:3: And I went down to the potter’s house, and behold, he was doing work upon the stones.
units.Jeremiah 18:4: And the vessel he was making fell apart in his hands, and again he made it another vessel, as pleased him to make.
units.Jeremiah 18:5: And the Lord’s word came to me, saying:
units.Jeremiah 18:6: Can I not shape you as this potter does, house of Israel? Behold, you are like the potter’s clay in My hands.
units.Jeremiah 18:7: At last I will speak concerning a nation or kingdom, to remove them and destroy,
units.Jeremiah 18:8: and if that nation turns from all their evils, I will change My mind concerning the evils I planned to do to them.
units.Jeremiah 18:9: And at last I will speak concerning a nation and kingdom, for it to be rebuilt and planted,
units.Jeremiah 18:10: and if they do evil things before Me by not hearing My voice, I will change My mind concerning the good things I spoke of doing for them.
units.Jeremiah 18:11: And now say to Judah’s men and those dwelling in Jerusalem: Behold, I am shaping evils against you and devising a design against you. Let each turn from his evil way now, and make your practices better.
units.Jeremiah 18:12: And they said: We will be resolute, because we will follow our turnings away, and each will do what pleases his evil heart.
units.Isaiah 55:8: For My counsels are not as your counsels, nor are My ways like your ways, says the Lord.
units.Isaiah 55:9: But as the heaven is distant from the earth, so is My way distant from your ways, and your thoughts from My mind.
units.Isaiah 55:10: For as rain or snow comes down from the heaven, and does not return until it has drenched the earth, and made it bring forth and sprout, and given seed to the sower and bread for food,
units.Isaiah 55:11: so it will be with My word, whatever goes out from My mouth: it will certainly not return until all that I have willed is accomplished; and I will prosper your ways and My commandments.
units.Isaiah 55:12: For you will go out in gladness, and in joy you will be taught; for the mountains and the hills will leap, welcoming you with joy, and all the trees of the field will clap their branches.
units.Isaiah 55:13: And the cypress will rise in place of the thorny shrub, and the myrtle will rise in place of the fleabane; and the Lord will be for a name and for an everlasting sign, and will not fail.
units.Ezekiel 24:1: The Lord’s word came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, saying,
units.Ezekiel 24:2: “Son of man, write for yourself a record of the day, from this day on which Babylon’s king pressed against Jerusalem, from this present day,
units.Ezekiel 24:3: and speak a parable against the provoking house. Say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: Set on the cauldron and pour water into it,
units.Ezekiel 24:4: and put the cut pieces into it, every good cut, leg and shoulder stripped from the bones,
units.Ezekiel 24:5: from choice animals taken. Burn the bones beneath them. It boiled, it boiled, and her bones have been cooked within her.
units.Ezekiel 24:6: Therefore thus says the Lord: O city of bloodshed! A cauldron with rust in it, whose rust has not come out of her! He brought it out limb by limb; no lot fell upon her.
units.Ezekiel 24:7: For her blood is within her. I have set it upon smooth rock; I have not poured it upon the earth to cover it with earth.
units.Ezekiel 24:8: To make wrath rise for vengeance to be exacted, I have set her blood upon smooth rock so that it will not be covered.
units.Ezekiel 24:9: Therefore thus says the Lord: I too will enlarge the firebrand
units.Ezekiel 24:10: and multiply the wood and kindle the fire, so that the flesh melts and the broth is reduced,
units.Ezekiel 24:11: and it stands upon the coals, so that its copper is scorched and heated and melts amid its uncleanness, and its rust ceases,
units.Ezekiel 24:12: yet her abundant rust certainly will not leave her; her rust will be put to shame,
units.Ezekiel 24:13: because you were being defiled. And what if you are not cleansed any more until I fill up My wrath?
units.Ezekiel 24:14: I, the Lord, have spoken, and it will come, and I will act. I will not draw back, nor will I show mercy. According to your ways and your reflections I will judge you, says the Lord. Therefore I will judge you according to your bloodshed, and according to your reflections I will judge you, the unclean one, the famous one, abundant in provoking.’”
units.Isaiah 2:6: For He abandoned His people, Israel’s house, because their country was filled, as from the beginning, with omens like the foreigners’ country, and many foreign children were born to them.
units.Isaiah 2:7: For their country was filled with silver and gold, and their treasures had no number; the land was filled with horses, and their chariots had no number.
units.Isaiah 2:8: The land was filled with abominations, the works of their hands, and they bowed before what their fingers made.
units.Isaiah 2:9: A human being bowed down, and a man was humbled; I will certainly not let them go.
units.Ezekiel 2:1: He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak to you.”
units.Ezekiel 2:2: A spirit came upon me, took me up, raised me, and set me on my feet; I heard Him speaking to me,
units.Ezekiel 2:3: and He said to me, “Son of man, I am sending you out to the house of Israel, those who embitter Me, who have embittered Me, they and their fathers, until this present day,
units.Ezekiel 2:4: and you will say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord.’
units.Ezekiel 2:5: If indeed they listen or are terrified—for it is an embittering house—they will know that you are a prophet among them.
units.Ezekiel 2:6: And you, son of man, do not fear them or be shaken before their faces, because they will rage and gather against you all around, and you dwell among scorpions. Do not fear their words or be shaken before their faces, for it is an embittering house.
units.Ezekiel 2:7: You will speak My words to them, if indeed they listen or are terrified, for it is an embittering house.
units.Ezekiel 3:4: He said to me, “Son of man, go, enter the house of Israel, and speak My words to them;
units.Ezekiel 3:5: for you are not sent out to a people of deep speech and heavy tongue, but to the house of Israel,
units.Ezekiel 3:6: nor to many peoples of foreign speech or foreign tongues, nor those strong in tongue whose words you will not understand. If I had sent you to such people, they would have listened to you.
units.Ezekiel 3:7: But the house of Israel certainly will not be willing to listen to you, because they do not wish to listen to Me; the entire house of Israel is contentious and hard-hearted.
units.Ezekiel 3:8: Behold, I have made your face strong against their faces, and I will strengthen your contention against their contention,
units.Ezekiel 3:9: and it will always be stronger than rock. Do not fear them or be terrified before their faces, for it is an embittering house.”
units.Ezekiel 3:10: He said to me, “Son of man, take into your heart all the words that I have spoken with you, and hear with your ears,
units.Ezekiel 3:11: and go, enter the captivity, to the sons of your people; you will speak to them and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord,’ if indeed they listen, if indeed they yield.”
units.Jeremiah 15:15: Lord, remember me and visit me and vindicate me against those pursuing me; do not delay. Know how I received reproach concerning Thee
units.Jeremiah 15:16: from those rejecting Thy words. Bring them to an end, and Thy word will become to me rejoicing and my heart’s joy, because Thy name has been called over me, Lord Almighty.
units.Jeremiah 15:17: I did not sit in their gathering as they played, but I was reverent before Thy hand. I sat alone because I was filled with bitterness.
units.Jeremiah 15:18: Why do those grieving me overpower me? My wound is firm; from where will I be healed? It indeed became to me like false water having no faithfulness.
units.Jeremiah 15:19: Therefore thus says the Lord: If you return, I will restore you, and you will stand before Me. If you bring out the honored from the unworthy, you will be as My mouth; and they will turn to you, and you will not turn to them.
units.Jeremiah 15:20: And I will make you to this people like a fortified bronze wall, and they will fight against you but certainly will not prevail against you, because I am with you to save you
units.Jeremiah 15:21: and to rescue you from the hand of evil people, and I will ransom you from the hand of pestilent people.
units.Hosea 2:1: The number of Israel’s sons was like the sand of the sea, which will not be measured or counted. In the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not My people,’ there they will be called sons of the living God.
units.Hosea 2:2: Judah’s sons and Israel’s sons will gather together, appoint one authority for themselves and come up from the land, for great is Jezreel’s day.
units.Hosea 2:3: Say to your brother, ‘My People,’ and to your sister, ‘Shown Mercy.’
units.Hosea 2:4: “Enter into judgment with your mother, enter into judgment! For she is not My wife and I am not her husband. I will remove her prostitution from My face and her adultery from between her breasts,
units.Hosea 2:5: so that I may strip her naked and restore her as on the day of her birth. I will make her like a wilderness, set her like a waterless land and kill her with thirst.
units.Hosea 2:6: I will certainly show no mercy to her children, for they are children of prostitution.
units.Hosea 2:7: For their mother prostituted herself; she who bore them brought shame. She said, ‘I will follow my lovers, who give me my loaves and water, my garments and linen cloths, my oil and everything due to me.’
units.Hosea 2:8: Therefore look, I block her way with thorns and will build up her roads, and she will certainly not find her path.
units.Hosea 2:9: She will pursue her lovers but certainly not catch them; she will seek them but certainly not find them. She will say, ‘I will go and return to my former husband, for it was better for me then than now.’
units.Hosea 2:10: She did not know that it was I who gave her grain, wine and oil and multiplied silver for her; but she made silver and gold objects for Baal.
units.Hosea 2:11: Therefore I will return and recover My grain at its season and My wine at its time; I will take away My garments and linen cloths so that they do not cover her shame.
units.Hosea 2:12: Now I will uncover her uncleanness before her lovers, and certainly no one will deliver her from My hand.
units.Hosea 2:13: I will turn away all her rejoicings, her festivals, new moons and Sabbaths, and all her festal assemblies.
units.Hosea 2:14: I will obliterate her vine and fig trees, of which she said, ‘These are my wages that my lovers gave me.’ I will make them a testimony, and the field’s beasts, heaven’s birds and the earth’s creeping things will devour them.”
units.Hosea 2:15: “I will exact vengeance upon her for the days of the Baalim, when she sacrificed to them, put on her earrings and necklaces and went after her lovers, but forgot Me,” says the Lord.
units.Hosea 2:16: “Therefore look, I am leading her astray; I will place her in a wilderness and speak to her heart,
units.Hosea 2:17: and from there I will give her her possessions and the Valley of Achor to open her understanding. There she will be humbled as in the days of her infancy and the days of her ascent from Egypt’s land.
units.Hosea 2:18: On that day,” says the Lord, “she will call Me ‘My Husband’ and no longer call Me ‘Baalim.’
units.Hosea 2:19: I will remove the names of the Baalim from her mouth, and they will certainly no longer remember their names.
units.Hosea 2:20: On that day I will establish a covenant for them with the field’s beasts, heaven’s birds and the earth’s creeping things. I will shatter bow, sword and war from the land and settle you in hope.
units.Hosea 2:21: I will betroth you to Myself forever; I will betroth you to Myself in righteousness and judgment, in mercy and compassion,
units.Hosea 2:22: and I will betroth you to Myself in faithfulness, and you will know the Lord.
units.Hosea 2:23: On that day,” says the Lord, “I will listen to heaven, and heaven will listen to the earth,
units.Hosea 2:24: and the earth will listen to grain, wine and oil, and they will listen to Jezreel.
units.Hosea 2:25: I will sow her for Myself upon the land, show mercy to Not Shown Mercy and say to Not My People, ‘You are My people.’ He will say, ‘Thou art the Lord my God!’”
units.James 1:16: Do not be led astray, my beloved brothers.
units.James 1:17: Every good act of giving and every complete gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom there is no variation or shadow from turning.
units.James 1:18: By His will He gave us birth through the word of truth, so that we might be a kind of firstfruits of His creatures.
units.Exodus 19:3: And Moses went up to the mountain of God; and God called to him from the mountain, saying, “This is what you shall say to the house of Jacob, and declare to the sons of Israel:
units.Exodus 19:4: ‘You yourselves have seen all that I have done to the Egyptians, and I bore you as upon eagles’ wings, and brought you to Myself.
units.Exodus 19:5: Now therefore, if you diligently listen to My voice, and keep My covenant, you shall be to Me a treasured people from among all the nations; for all the earth is Mine.

units.Genesis 1:23: And there was evening, and there was morning: a fifth day.

units.Ezekiel 13:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 13:2: “Son of man, prophesy against Israel’s prophets; you will prophesy and say to them, ‘Hear the Lord’s word!
units.Ezekiel 13:3: Thus says the Lord: Woe to those who prophesy from their own heart and see nothing at all!
units.Ezekiel 13:4: Your prophets, Israel, are like foxes in the wildernesses.
units.Ezekiel 13:5: They did not stand in a firm position, and they gathered flocks against the house of Israel. Those saying, ‘On the Lord’s day,’ did not rise.
units.Ezekiel 13:6: They see false things and divine vain things, those who say, ‘The Lord says,’ although the Lord has not sent them; and they began to establish a word.
units.Ezekiel 13:7: Have you not seen a false vision and spoken vain divinations?
units.Ezekiel 13:8: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Because your words are false and your divinations vain, therefore behold, I am against you, says the Lord,
units.Ezekiel 13:9: and I will stretch out My hand against the prophets who see false things and utter vain things. They will not belong to My people’s instruction, nor be written in the register of the house of Israel, nor enter Israel’s land. They will know that I am the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 23:25: I heard what the prophets speak, the false things they prophesy in My name, saying, I dreamed a dream.
units.Jeremiah 23:26: How long will it be in the heart of the prophets prophesying false things, and in their prophesying the wishes of their own heart?
units.Jeremiah 23:27: They plan to forget My law through their dreams, which each told his neighbor, just as their fathers forgot My name through Baal.
units.Jeremiah 23:28: Let the prophet in whom there is a dream tell his dream, and the one to whom My word comes tell My word in truth. What has chaff to do with wheat? So are My words, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 23:29: Are not My words like blazing fire, says the Lord, and like an axe cutting rock?
units.Jeremiah 23:30: Therefore behold, I am against the prophets, says the Lord God, who steal My words, each from his neighbor.
units.Jeremiah 23:31: Behold, I am against the prophets who cast out prophecies of the tongue and doze their own dozing.
units.Jeremiah 23:32: Behold, I am against the prophets who prophesy false dreams, who told them and led My people astray by their lies and wanderings. I did not send or command them, and they will bring this people no benefit at all.
units.Deuteronomy 28:47: because you did not serve the Lord your God with gladness and a good heart, for the abundance of all things.

units.Isaiah 6:8: And I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go to this people? And I said, Behold, here I am; send me.

units.Zephaniah 3:1: O conspicuous and redeemed city, the dove-city!
units.Zephaniah 3:2: She did not heed a voice or accept discipline; she did not trust the Lord or approach her God.

units.Zephaniah 3:7: I said, “Only fear Me and accept discipline, and you will certainly not be destroyed from her eyes,” with all I exacted upon her. Prepare, rise early! All their gleaning has been ruined.
units.Isaiah 17:4: On that day Jacob’s glory will fail, and the fat parts of his glory will be shaken.

units.Ezekiel 13:11: say to those coating it, ‘It will fall.’ There will be a flooding downpour, and I will put stones for hurling into their bonds, and they will fall; there will be an upending wind, and it will be split.
units.Ezekiel 13:12: And behold, the wall has fallen! Will they not say to you, ‘Where is your coating with which you coated it?’
units.Ezekiel 13:13: Therefore thus says the Lord: I will unleash an upending blast with wrath; a flooding downpour will come in My anger, and I will bring the projectile stones in wrath for complete destruction,
units.Ezekiel 13:14: and I will tear down the wall you coated, and it will fall. I will lay it upon the ground; its foundations will be uncovered, and it will fall, and you will be brought to an end with rebukes. You will recognize that I am the Lord.

units.Jeremiah 18:15: Because My people forgot Me, they burned incense in vain; and they will become weak in their ways, the age-old tracks, to step upon paths having no road for travel,
units.Jeremiah 18:16: to make their land a ruin and an eternal hissing; all who pass through it will be astonished and shake their head.

units.Ezekiel 33:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 33:2: “Son of man, speak to your people’s sons and say to them, ‘If I bring a sword upon a land, and the land’s people take one man from among themselves and appoint him as their watchman,
units.Ezekiel 33:3: and he sees the sword coming upon the land, sounds the trumpet and signals to the people,
units.Ezekiel 33:4: and a hearer hears the trumpet’s sound but does not take care, and the sword comes upon him and overtakes him, his blood will be upon his own head.
units.Ezekiel 33:5: Because he heard the trumpet’s sound and did not take care, his blood will be upon himself. But this one, because he took care, rescued his life.
units.Ezekiel 33:6: If the watchman sees the sword coming but does not signal with the trumpet, and the people do not take care, and the sword comes and takes a life from them, that life was taken because of its own lawlessness, but I will require the blood from the watchman’s hand.’
units.Ezekiel 33:7: And you, son of man, I have appointed you a watchman for Israel’s house, and you will hear a word from My mouth.
units.Ezekiel 33:8: When I say to the sinner, ‘You will surely be put to death,’ and you do not speak so that the impious man may guard himself from his way, that lawless man will die in his lawlessness, but I will require his blood from your hand.
units.Ezekiel 33:9: But if you forewarn the impious man of his way so that he may turn from it and he does not turn from his way, this man will die in his impiety, and you have rescued your own life.
units.Proverbs 1:20: Wisdom is celebrated at the exits, and in the squares she speaks openly.
units.Proverbs 1:21: At the tops of walls she is proclaimed; at rulers’ gates she sits nearby, and at city gates she speaks boldly:
units.Proverbs 1:22: As long as the innocent hold to righteousness, they will not be ashamed. But the senseless, desiring insolence, became ungodly and hated perception,
units.Proverbs 1:23: and became liable to reproofs. Behold, I will send forth to you an utterance of my breath, and I will teach you my word.
units.Proverbs 1:24: Since I kept calling and you did not obey, and kept extending words and you paid no attention,
units.Proverbs 1:25: but you were making my counsels ineffective and disobeyed my reproofs,
units.Proverbs 1:26: therefore I too will laugh at your ruin and exult when destruction comes to you,
units.Proverbs 1:27: and when sudden tumult reaches you and overthrow arrives like a storm, when affliction and siege come upon you, or when destruction comes to you.
units.Proverbs 1:28: For when you call upon me, I will not listen to you; evil people will seek me and will not find me,
units.Proverbs 1:29: for they hated wisdom and did not choose the fear of the Lord,
units.Proverbs 1:30: nor did they want to attend to my counsels, but they were sneering at my reproofs.
units.Proverbs 1:31: Therefore they will eat the fruits of their own way and be filled with their own ungodliness.
units.Proverbs 1:32: For because they wronged the innocent, they will be murdered, and examination will destroy the ungodly.
units.Proverbs 1:33: But whoever listens to me will dwell in hope and rest fearlessly from every evil.

units.Isaiah 1:11: “What is the multitude of your sacrifices to Me?” says the Lord. “I am full of burnt offerings of rams; fat of lambs and blood of bulls and male goats I do not desire,
units.Isaiah 1:12: not even if you come to appear before Me. For who demanded these things from your hands? To trample My court,
units.Isaiah 1:13: you will no longer continue. If you bring fine flour, it is futile. Incense is an abomination to Me. Your new moons and sabbaths and a great day I cannot endure; fasting and idleness,
units.Isaiah 1:14: and your new moons and your festivals My soul hates. You have become more than enough for Me; I will no longer let your sins go.
units.Isaiah 1:15: Whenever you stretch your hands toward Me, I will turn My eyes away from you. Even if you multiply supplication, I will not listen to you, for your hands are full of blood.

units.Lamentations 1:19: I called my lovers, but they deceived me. My priests and my elders failed in the city, for they sought food for themselves to restore their lives, and found none.
units.Lamentations 1:20: See, Lord, how I am afflicted! My belly is troubled, and my heart has turned within me, for I have bitterly provoked. Outside the sword bereaved me, like death in the house.
units.Lamentations 1:21: Hear now that I groan; there is no one to comfort me. All my enemies heard of my calamities and rejoiced because Thou didst do it. Thou didst bring a day, Thou didst call a time, and they became like me.
units.Lamentations 1:22: May all their wickedness come before Thee, and glean them as they made a gleaning for all my sins; for my groans are many and my heart is grieved.

units.Ezekiel 22:18: “Son of man, behold, Israel’s house has become mixed to Me, all of them with copper, iron, tin and lead; it is mixed amid silver.
units.Ezekiel 22:19: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Because all of you became one mixture, therefore I am receiving you into Jerusalem.
